statusNote: Complex lineage: this entity descends from Mount St. Clare College (Catholic, Clinton IA) -> The Franciscan University of the Prairies (2003) -> sold to Bridgepoint Education and renamed Ashford University (2005, for-profit, went fully online, Iowa campus closed 2016) -> acquired by the University of Arizona and reconstituted as the nonprofit University of Arizona Global Campus / UAGC (transaction completed Dec 1, 2020). In July 2023 the University of Arizona directly absorbed UAGC (ending its separate nonprofit board/CEO structure), and UAGC is being fully integrated into Arizona Online with a target completion around 2026. Since the 2023 absorption there has been no distinct "UAGC president"; day-to-day leadership has passed through interim SVP and special-advisor roles reporting into University of Arizona central administration (currently President Suresh Garimella, named UA's 23rd president, Oct 2024). Leaders below through 2005 governed the institution under its Mount St. Clare/Franciscan name; from 2005-2020 as Ashford University; from Dec 2020 as UAGC.
